name: SQL Injection
guidance: Query built by string concatenation/formatting with external input. Fix: parameterized queries / ORM bindings.

name: OS Command Injection
guidance: External input reaches a shell command. Fix: pass an argument list, shell=False, validate against an allow-list.

name: Cross-Site Scripting
guidance: Unescaped user data in HTML. Fix: context-aware output encoding, avoid raw HTML sinks.

name: Hard-coded Credentials
guidance: Secret committed in source. Fix: load from environment or a secret manager and rotate the leaked value.

name: Weak Cryptographic Algorithm
guidance: Broken hash/cipher. Fix: SHA-256+ for integrity; bcrypt/scrypt/argon2 for passwords; AES-GCM.

name: Weak PRNG
guidance: Non-cryptographic RNG used for security values. Fix: secrets module / crypto.randomBytes.

name: Unsafe Deserialization
guidance: Deserializing untrusted data can run code. Fix: JSON, yaml.safe_load, signed data.

name: Path Traversal
guidance: User-controlled path escapes the intended directory. Fix: resolve and verify the path is inside the base directory.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
guidance: Server fetches a user-supplied URL. Fix: allow-list hosts, block internal ranges, no redirects to private IPs.

name: Missing Authentication/Authorization
guidance: Endpoint or object access without an auth/ownership check. Fix: enforce authN and per-object authZ server-side.

name: Improper Certificate Validation
guidance: TLS verification disabled. Fix: keep verification on, pin/trust the right CA.

name: Debug Mode Enabled
guidance: Debug features exposed in production. Fix: disable debug, use environment-based config.

name: Sensitive Data in Logs
guidance: Secrets or personal data written to logs. Fix: redact before logging.

name: Unmaintained/Outdated Component
guidance: Pin and update dependencies; run a dependency audit tool.
